fusions.name: Awl Through Mail
fusions.desc: A boring thrust that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds up to 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Maiden's Embrace
fusions.desc: Spikes close in around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
